en.<p class=\"eyebrow\">Needle Roller & Cag:
Needle Roller & Cage Assemblies

Needle Cage (General & Connecting Rod Use)

A bearing in which needle rollers are assembled with a cage. Without an inner or outer ring, it is used directly combined with a heat-treated and ground shaft and housing bore, allowing it to support large loads in a small installation space.

It is divided into the general-purpose needle cage (KT/KT···N/KTW) and the needle cage for connecting rods (KT···EG/KTV···EG), specialized for the big end and small end of engine connecting rods.

You can search by entering just part of the model number or dimensions.

Needle Cages (General-Purpose / Connecting Rod)

A bearing type in which needle rollers are assembled in a retainer (cage). With no inner or outer ring, it is used directly against a heat-treated, ground shaft and housing bore, so it can support heavy loads in a small installation space.

They are divided into general-purpose needle cages (KT/KT···N/KTW) and connecting rod needle cages (KT···EG/KTV···EG) specialized for the big and small ends of engine connecting rods.

ニードルケージ(汎用・コネクティングロッド用)
